title: Molten Dutch Stamppot Casserole
description: A Mexican-inspired twist on traditional Dutch stamppot, featuring molten cheese and crispy lardons.
instructions: In a large skillet, cook lardons over medium-high heat until crispy.
In a separate pan, combine stamppot and sour cream. Stir until heated through.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, arrange a layer of stamppot mixture.
Top with a layer of shredded cheese and crispy lardons.
Repeat steps 3-5 until all ingredients are used, finishing with a layer of cheese on top.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbly.
Drizzle with molten sauce and serve hot.
